mapper.select: SELECT so.id, so.order_no, so.platform_order_no, so.platform_id, p.name AS platform_name, p.color AS platform_color, so.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, so.receiver_name, so.receiver_phone, so.receiver_address, so.receiver_name_hash, so.receiver_phone_hash, so.order_status, so.total_amount, so.remark, so.paid_at, so.shipped_at, so.finished_at, so.deleted, so.created_at, so.updated_at FROM sales_order so LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON so.warehouse_id = w.id LEFT JOIN platform p ON so.platform_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE so.id = #{id} AND so.deleted = 0

SELECT so.id, so.order_no, so.platform_order_no, so.platform_id, p.name AS platform_name, p.color AS platform_color, so.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, so.receiver_name, so.receiver_phone, so.receiver_address, so.receiver_name_hash, so.receiver_phone_hash, so.order_status, so.total_amount, so.remark, so.paid_at, so.shipped_at, so.finished_at, so.deleted, so.created_at, so.updated_at FROM sales_order so LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON so.warehouse_id = w.id LEFT JOIN platform p ON so.platform_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE so.order_no = #{orderNo} AND so.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_order (order_no, platform_order_no, platform_id, warehouse_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, receiver_name_hash, receiver_phone_hash, order_status, total_amount, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{platformOrderNo}, #{platformId}, #{warehouseId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{receiverNameHash}, #{receiverPhoneHash}, #{orderStatus}, #{totalAmount}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE sales_order SET shipped_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT so.id, so.order_no, so.platform_order_no, so.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, so.receiver_name, so.receiver_phone, so.receiver_address, so.receiver_name_hash, so.receiver_phone_hash, so.order_status, so.total_amount, so.remark, so.paid_at, so.shipped_at, so.finished_at, so.deleted, so.created_at, so.updated_at FROM sales_order so LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON so.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE so.deleted = 0 AND so.id > #{lastId} ORDER BY so.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sales_order SET receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, receiver_address = #{receiverAddress}, receiver_name_hash = #{receiverNameHash}, receiver_phone_hash = #{receiverPhoneHash} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
